headline: US Threatens to Remove South Africa from AGOA Trade Pact
summary: US President Donald Trump has given notice of intent to remove South Africa from the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) starting January 1, 2027. Trade Minister Parks Tau stated that Pretoria will continue negotiating while assessing potential impacts on exporters and businesses.
why: AGOA provides duty-free access to the US market for eligible sub-Saharan African nations, making its potential loss a significant structural risk for South African exporters and trade-reliant sectors.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Removal from the AGOA trade agreement threatens South African export revenues to the United States.
